NewsArticle.Title: Server Reboot
NewsArticle.Content: - 08.06 10:16 - 08.06 10:26 - 08.08 13:43 - 08.08 13:49 - 08.08 13:57 A Dark Ages server rebooted unexpectedly at these dates and times (PDT) due to a software error. Service resumed immediately. In each case the faulty code was isolated and corrected within 2 hours of the reboot. At all other times all Dark Ages servers are stable. The Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load.
